verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud publishes a pricing calculator with configurable cluster options (High Availability, Search Delivery Network, GPU acceleration). It says you get a dedicated cluster with no limits on records or operations, which suggests node/cluster-based pricing that avoids per-search or per-record overages. Self-hosting is free under GPL-3.0. However, the evidence never shows actual published rates or how cluster size maps to price, so the founder cannot be shown to predict a specific cost. Missing for 10: actual published per-node/cluster prices, documentation of how calculator inputs map to cost, independent corroboration of cost predictability.
